system.description:
Whether a condition held in life or an odd side effect of the Embrace, your nervous system is missing a few connections — you have very little tactile sense, whether pleasure or pain. You suffer a penalty to notice tactile warnings (a blade at your back, or in it), and the Storyteller may require a roll to notice even blatant harm — you might not realize you've been shot if it doesn't knock you down outright.

However, your deadened nerves also protect you from pain, letting you shrug off wounds far past the point a normal vampire would be crippled by them.

MET System: You suffer no penalties for wounds until reaching the Wounded health level; at Wounded you lose only one Trait's worth of penalty (rather than the normal scaling), and even at Crippled you act at only a minor penalty. In exchange, the Storyteller may keep your actual health-level state secret from you, describing injuries only vaguely.
